findings.summary: The brief requires publishing URL-shortener acceptance results that no loop session can verify, and its proposed real-data gate deliberately excludes them.
findings.evidence: docs/briefs/B20261126-1418-b45-docs-mixed-os-and-any-agent.loop-brief.md:151-153 makes the external run part of the README model claim; lines 201-206 hard-code 10 of 10 tasks, all first-pass, and about $1.31 from metrics outside this repository and say no session here checks them. Lines 299-305 gate only the in-repository B40-B44 metrics and B39 run record. docs/design-notes/copilot-cli-experiments.md has no matching mai-code-2 section or these figures. This conflicts with .claude/skills/vloop-architect/SKILL.md:34-37, which requires real telemetry and a real-data check readable from this repository, and with the create-brief guideline that paths outside the repository cannot bind (skills/create-brief/guidelines.md:44).
findings.fix: Operator choice: provide a repository-contained, cited capture of the acceptance telemetry and make task 1's gate read the task count, first-pass count, cost and session-kind evidence from it; or remove the external acceptance-run figures and broaden the README/D6 claim only to the B40-B44 evidence this repository can verify.

decisions: Use agent-neutral wording where both agents apply, while preserving the explicitly Claude-only sections and commands. I agree.
Give mixed macOS/Windows teams a short README section and keep the full treatment in docs/guide/configuration.md. I agree.
Report what mai-code-2 has run but stop short of calling it qualified. I agree.
Put the repository's operator and architect skills in scope because this mixed team's gates are pwsh. I agree, provided those skill constraints are changed in this same run.
Do not pin prose line numbers; locate changes by their named text. I agree.
Leave Spanish templates and docs/domain out of scope. I agree.
Accept the operator's external URL-shortener acceptance totals as publishable evidence without repository-local telemetry. This needs the operator's approval or one of the fixes in the finding.
